description: Boundaries through the settlement service on the actual engine (S5 content, POL5-BAL, a 40-minute first session): absences of 0, 1 ms, 2 ms, 24 h - 1 ms, 24 h, 24 h + 1 ms, 72 h - 1 ms, 72 h, 72 h + 1 ms, 72 h + 1 day and 30 days; a negative absence, a trusted clock running backwards and a future reconnect.
